checked_profile.summary: Undergraduate borrowing with several in-school payment choices and conditional cosigner release.
checked_profile.scope: This check covers undergraduate repayment choices and the published cosigner-release criteria. It does not establish your APR, approval, total borrowing eligibility or a complete fee schedule.

facts.label: In-school choices
facts.text: College Ave lists immediate principal-and-interest, interest-only, fixed $25 monthly and deferred payment options for undergraduate loans. Compare the total cost of the options in your own offer.

facts.label: Release timing
facts.text: Cosigner release is not automatic after 24 payments. College Ave requires at least half the original repayment term to have elapsed; its example places a 10-year loan at the fifth year of principal-and-interest repayment.

facts.label: Release qualifications
facts.text: The primary borrower must request release, be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident, document annual income at least twice the outstanding balance and pass a credit review. The criteria also address recent delinquencies, bankruptcy, foreclosure and repossession.
